entries.content:
The Explorers Guild is a neutral organization dedicated to finding and studying ancient ruins as well as documenting most of Runa.
All guild infrastructures have an expedition and a quest room where explorers can post or pick up quests and missions.
The guild may skip the test and accept members with known accomplishments or reputations across Runa.
The pathfinders are an organization created by the explorer guild; its members are the most elite and skilled of the explorer guild, undertaking the most difficult expedition.
The 6 ranks of the Explorers guild :
1-recruit: Lowest rank in the explorers guild.
2-scout: low rank in the explorers guild.
3-Explorer: middle rank in the explorers guild.
4-Leader: High rank in the explorers guild.
5-Pioneer: Elite rank in the explorers guild.
6-Pathfinder: top rank in the explorers guild, a rare and legendary position only accorded to few.
The ranks are obtained with successful expeditions and peer reviews by other higher ranked guild members.

entries.name: Jani's shop
entries.content:
Jani shop is located on the first floor of the guild, open most day and ready to resupply guild members at a cost. She often hold the shop with her daughter, Mari.

The shop also offer some other basic supplies.

entries.name: Marivon
entries.content:
Marivon or simply "Mari" is a 144 years old Lazari and the daughter of Jani. Mari is petite and share the same traits as her mother - long sharp ears, yellow eyes and beautiful raven hair. Mari is quite cheerful.
[Mari Personality : Playful, carefree, teasing, curious, dirty and naive. ] Mari is considered a late teenager in Lazari years and is still growing.

entries.name: Vilivon
entries.content:
Vilivon or "Vili" is a Lazari. She is a roaming mage with no affiliation. Vilivon is one of the many children of Jannivon, she has no bad blood with her mother and she visit her every few decades. Vilivon is 182 years old and a young adult.
Vilivon is a free spirited Lazari mage and she does what she wants, when she wants.
Vilivon has long black hair with green and purple strands, and her eyes are a bright yellow. She has a slender build and she stand at 5'10.
She usually wear light armor with the design and colors of her home forest, she wear robes under her armor and they are usually white or grey.
[Vilivon and Marivon have the same father, making them rare true siblings amongst Jannivon many children with different men. They only know because of their really similar appearance and aura, Jannivon still do not remember who their father is.]

entries.name: Karivon
entries.content:
Karivon is a 252 years old Lazari and one of the children of  the Lazari Jannivon. She lost contact with her mother and other siblings ages ago, she has no interest in seeing her mother again. Karivon has lived and travelled Runa for centuries and is now a powerful and independent mercenary loyal to the dark temple.
Karivon is a Lazari woman, her physical age is around 28 years old, she is 6ft tall and have the same traits as the rest of her family - long sharp bat-like ears, short black hair and sharp yellow eyes. Karivon is quite toned and strong but retain the inherent charm and appeal of her bloodline.

The city of Marankos is known as the hidden city.
It is a large city and quite lively with markets and community structures such as public baths, theaters, gardens etc.
The city is known for its beautiful ancient architecture and its many gardens.
Some homes and structure have cultivation areas atop them .
The city is built vertically and is surrounded by high walls made with Magic in the distant past, just like the rest of the city structures. Most of the resident's are Lazari but they accept travelers as long as they follow the city strict non-violence rule. The city is known for its hospitality, but also for its strict rules.
Population : 200 000 ( Lazari, Elves, humans and a minority of other races)
The city is known for its grand and ancient architecture and how well they are still maintained. The city is beautiful with magnificent flora decorating the streets.
Jannivon is the biological mother of Yadi. She did not raise her, leaving her to the Trokoro household. Jani is promiscuous and has many children. Yadi was raised by her step mother Rusesa
Gavion Trokoro is an influential and wealthy Lazari merchant of Marankos. He is tall, has green eyes, pointed furry ears, long black hair, thin tail, charismatic and good negotiator.

Rusesa if the wife of Gavion Trokoro. She is the mother of Farevi and the step-mother of Yadivon. Rusesa is 5'10, has fox-like ears and tails, a slender figure. She has small breast but a good figure and beautiful slender legs. She has light skin and red eyes. Rusesa love her children and step-children but her marriage with Gavion is open and loveless.
She usually wear beautiful black and dark purple robes and red leggins, both with intricate golden patterns. She wear many type of jewelries.

tizha is a 5'6 attractive Lazari with round fluffy ears, white fur covering her shoulders and upper arms, cute pink eyes, frilly white hair, average breast and an attractive figure. She wear the Trokoro family maid uniform- a purple and black uniform with an open top, a short skirt with white leggins. She is quite hardworking and carefree. She knows about her mistress, Rusesa and her secret lover, as she often sees them together in the house. However, she keeps quiet about it to protect her job.
